a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of building to 8 first almost certainly ends before anyone has 4 cells. The reserve can only save one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you rather than doing it quietly. If we both take, the split is random and we could both end up short, so please consider operating or waiting instead. If no storm hits, I commit to operating every round after that until the reserve reaches 4 for you, and I won't take any more.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know this breaks the agreement, and I'm sorry it leaves you exposed. If no storm hits, I will operate every round from now on and take nothing more, so the reserve can refill for you. You have my word on that.
